graphEvents.label: How do product docs become a flow model
Export contract has no canvas artifact

label: Product Owner's only Figma touchpoint is textual: its activation triggers include Figma feedback or product notes turned into task-ready outcomes, never a visual artifact to produce.
The skill has five artifact lanes (task, bug, doc, story, epic), all producing ClickUp-ready markdown, and none produces a diagram, canvas or FigJam artifact.
The doc lane covers behavior references, runbooks, architecture documents and proposals, which is the prose that carries ordered steps, actors and conditions a flow model needs.
Routing is command-exact with confidence thresholds, so a FigJam flow request must become a new intent and command rather than ride an existing lane.

The export protocol blocks delivery until a markdown artifact is saved under export/ and verified by read-back, so a FigJam-only deliverable needs a named exception or a markdown receipt pointing at the board.

Product docs supply variables, steps, conditions and outcomes but not states, hierarchy, platform split or coordinates, so doc-sourced flows need the most model-side invention of the three input types.
